ai.title: AI Is Making Social Security Faster, but Can It Make It Fairer?
ai.description: China’s integration of artificial intelligence into social security administration is delivering measurable efficiency gains, expanding round-the-clock access to services and reducing manual workloads. An ILO report examining 45 cases across 15 provincial-level regions highlights how intelligent public services can strengthen social protection while raising critical questions about algorithmic fairness, human oversight, data privacy and digital inclusion.

ai.title: EU sees over €200 billion in missed tax revenues per year
ai.description: The European Commission reported a massive loss of over €200 billion annually due to tax fraud. This revenue loss stems from tax evasion, avoidance, and administrative shortcomings across member states. Approximately €125 billion is lost from value-added tax, while corporate income tax losses reach nearly €50 billion. The Commission suggests adopting technologies like artificial intelligence to enhance tax collection efforts.
